project.name: Prince Edu Hub GBP & Growth Automation Suite
project.description: Multi-location Google Business Profile management, AI-driven review replies, daily WhatsApp growth digest, campus target planning, and visitor chatbot for Prince Edu Hub educational institutions.

nodes.name: Google Business Profile Sync & Operations
nodes.summary: Handles Google OAuth2 authentication, multi-location discovery, bidirectional review syncing, post publishing, and educational program catalog maintenance across all Prince Edu Hub campuses.

businessRules: Campus staff can only view profiles assigned to their campus wing unless authenticated as system admin.
Deleted or flagged Google reviews must not be displayed in active reporting once purged upstream.
Rate limits on Google API calls must be respected with token refresh throttling.
crossDomainInteractions: Supplies real-time review stream to the AI Reply Automation engine.
Feeds daily rating counters to the Daily WhatsApp Growth and Target Planner.
Streams verified 5-star testimonials to the Website Widget.

nodes.name: Live Review Sync Pipeline
nodes.summary: Fetches updated reviews from Google Business Profile API v4, computes rating averages and response rates, and syncs records into MySQL.

nodes.name: Validate & Refresh OAuth Token
nodes.summary: Verifies Google access token freshness; requests new token from refresh credentials if expired.

nodes.name: Query Google Business API
nodes.summary: Calls Google My Business v4 endpoint to retrieve recent reviews with author avatars, star ratings, and comment text.

nodes.name: Store & Update Database Records
nodes.summary: Upserts reviews in MySQL, sanitizes reviewer names, updates local cache, and computes campus rating velocity.

nodes.name: Gemini AI Review Reply Engine
nodes.summary: Automates respectful, personalized responses to campus Google reviews using Google Gemini 2.5 Flash, following customized institutional tone rules.

businessRules: 5-star reviews receive polite gratitude with campus highlight points.
Negative reviews (1-2 stars) trigger courteous grievance redressal with verified office contact numbers.
Negative keywords must prevent auto-posting until human verification.
crossDomainInteractions: Reads incoming unreplied reviews from GBP Operations domain.
Sends generated reply payloads back to Google API for public publishing.

nodes.name: AI Reply Generation & Publishing
nodes.summary: Evaluates star rating, constructs prompt with campus tone rules, queries Gemini Flash, and publishes the reply to Google.

nodes.name: Evaluate Rating & Keyword Rules
nodes.summary: Checks star filter, negative blacklist triggers, and applies campus-specific instructions.

nodes.name: Generate Draft with Gemini AI
nodes.summary: Calls Google Gemini 2.5 Flash API with institutional context to generate polite, natural response in Hindi or English.

nodes.name: Publish Reply to Google Profile
nodes.summary: Calls Google reviews/reply endpoint to publish the approved text live onto Google Maps and Search.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Growth Reports & Member Targets
nodes.summary: Aggregates day-over-day review growth across all Prince Edu Hub institutions (PCP, Prince School, Prince College, NDA Academy, Prince Hospital), generates morning executive WhatsApp digests, and tracks daily staff targets.

businessRules: Report operates strictly on Indian Standard Time (Asia/Kolkata).
Calculates net review change (today count minus historical baseline).
Automated target distribution must balance remaining weekly quota across 7 days realistically.
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes live rating counters from GBP Operations.
Provides printable PDF audit summaries for campus executive meetings.

nodes.name: Morning WhatsApp Growth Digest Generation
nodes.summary: Aggregates all campus ratings, compares against yesterday, groups by campus in-charge, and formats a clean WhatsApp message.

nodes.name: Aggregate Campus Ratings & Growth
nodes.summary: Loops through all active campus Google Business Profiles, calculating net increase and baseline delta.

nodes.name: Compose WhatsApp Formatted Markdown
nodes.summary: Applies bold profile names, star ratings, campus in-charge phone numbers, and summary totals formatted for WhatsApp.

nodes.name: Website Widget & Visitor Live Chatbot
nodes.summary: Powers the embeddable Google review badge on institution websites and delivers real-time two-way messaging between campus counselors and prospective students.

businessRules: Visitors can engage with automated flow trees or transfer to live campus counselor.
Counselor internal notes must never be exposed to public visitor session.
All live chat sessions auto-sync via Server-Sent Events (SSE) or polling.
crossDomainInteractions: Pulls verified 5-star Google review snippets for social proof inside the widget.
Feeds lead contact numbers to WhatsApp admissions outreach.

nodes.name: Live Visitor Messaging & Counselor Inbox
nodes.summary: Manages visitor conversations, counselor assignment, real-time message streaming, and internal private staff notes.

nodes.name: Store & Route Visitor Message
nodes.summary: Ingests visitor inquiry, validates session, updates conversation status, and triggers staff notifications.

nodes.name: Stream Real-Time Updates
nodes.summary: Dispatches Server-Sent Events to connected counselor dashboard and visitor iframe.

nodes.name: Campus Security & Wing Isolation
nodes.summary: Enforces role-based permissions, OTP verification, and strict campus wing data isolation so designated coordinators only access their own institution.

businessRules: Admin users have global visibility across all 12+ Prince Edu Hub branches.
Member users are restricted strictly to reviews and posts of their designated campus wing.
Authentication endpoints are strictly rate-limited against brute force.
crossDomainInteractions: Secures all API endpoints across GBP, WhatsApp Reporting, and Live Chat.
Filters data models globally before serialization to frontend components.

nodes.name: Campus Data Isolation Barrier
nodes.summary: Inspects session user role and assigned wing; filters database queries to only return authorized locations and reviews.

nodes.name: Inspect Session & Assigned Wing
nodes.summary: Determines whether requesting user has admin privileges or restricted campus coordinator role.

nodes.name: Filter Query Records by Campus Wing
nodes.summary: Applies wing whitelist filter to locations, reviews, posts, and daily target records before rendering.

edges.description: Streams unreplied Google reviews into Gemini AI reply pipeline
Provides review count and rating baseline for WhatsApp digests and target tracking
Streams verified 5-star testimonials into the live website review carousel
Guards campus profiles by authenticated coordinator wing
